bagPolicy.summary: Backpacks of any kind are prohibited. The Exit/In FAQ does not list a maximum dimension or clear requirement for other bags.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Nearby paid options include a garage across from the venue and a lot behind it on Louise Avenue; street spaces on Louise and Elliston Place are limited.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The venue recommends rideshare because parking is limited, but its FAQ does not designate a specific pickup or drop-off curb.

concessions.summary: Outside food and beverages are prohibited. An outdoor smoking area is available to the left of the room.

accessibility.summary: The venue is mainly standing room, with a limited number of seats available first come first served. Contact the venue before the show for ADA accommodations.
